record.field: Building Fire Emergency Response - Dubai
fire

Fire Emergency Response Protocol

This procedure is aligned with Dubai Civil Defense regulations and UAE Fire and Life Safety Code.

When to Use:

  • Smoke detected in building
  • Fire alarm activated
  • Visible flames or fire
  • Smell of burning materials

Key Contacts:

  • Dubai Civil Defense: 997
  • Emergency Police: 999
  • Ambulance: 998
emergency@dubaipolice.gov.ae

FIRE EMERGENCY - Immediate Response Required Location: [SITE_NAME] Address: [SITE_ADDRESS] Reported By: [GUARD_NAME] Time: [TIMESTAMP]
Please respond immediately.
IMMEDIATELY SOUND THE FIRE ALARM - Press nearest fire alarm call point

Critical Action: Break the glass on the nearest fire alarm call point and activate the alarm.

Location of fire alarm points should be known from your site orientation.
Do not delay - every second counts in fire emergencies
CALL DUBAI CIVIL DEFENSE - Dial 997 immediately

Information to Provide:

  • Your exact location and address
  • Nature of fire (building, vehicle, electrical, etc.)
  • Floor/area affected
  • Number of people potentially affected
  • Any hazardous materials present
  • Your callback number

Speak clearly and do not hang up until told to do so.
Provide accurate location information - delays in locating can be fatal
ATTEMPT FIRE SUPPRESSION (ONLY IF SAFE) - Use nearest fire extinguisher if fire is small and contained

PASS Method for Fire Extinguisher Use:

  • Pull the pin
  • Aim at the base of the fire
  • Squeeze the handle
  • Sweep from side to side

ONLY attempt if:

  • Fire is small (size of wastebasket or smaller)
  • You have a clear escape route
  • You are trained in extinguisher use
  • The fire is not spreading rapidly

If any doubt - EVACUATE IMMEDIATELY
NEVER risk your life - if fire is large or spreading, evacuate immediately. Do not fight electrical fires with water extinguishers.
INITIATE EVACUATION - Begin organized evacuation of all personnel

Evacuation Procedure:

  • Announce evacuation clearly and calmly
  • Direct people to nearest safe exit
  • Check all rooms and areas systematically
  • Assist elderly, disabled, or injured persons
  • Close all doors and windows (do not lock)
  • Do NOT use elevators - use stairs only
  • Feel doors before opening - if hot, use alternate route

Stay Low: If smoke present, stay low to ground where air is clearer.
Never use elevators during fire. Smoke inhalation is the leading cause of fire deaths.
ASSEMBLY POINT - Direct all evacuees to designated assembly point

At Assembly Point:

  • Keep people at safe distance (minimum 50 meters from building)
  • Conduct headcount of all personnel
  • Report any missing persons to Civil Defense upon arrival
  • Do not allow anyone to re-enter building
  • Keep access routes clear for emergency vehicles
Do not allow anyone to return to building until Civil Defense declares it safe
SECURE THE AREA - Establish perimeter and control access

Site Security Actions:

  • Establish security cordon around affected area
  • Direct emergency vehicles to fire location
  • Keep bystanders and unauthorized persons away
  • Document all personnel entering/exiting area
  • Protect property from looting if safe to do so
Maintain safe distance - buildings can collapse even after fire is suppressed
COORDINATE WITH CIVIL DEFENSE - Brief emergency responders upon arrival

Information to Provide:

  • Location and extent of fire
  • Building layout and access points
  • Location of hazardous materials
  • Number of people evacuated and any missing persons
  • Actions already taken
  • Location of fire fighting equipment and shutoffs
DOCUMENT INCIDENT - Take photos and detailed notes of incident

Documentation Required:

  • Photos of affected areas (once safe to do so)
  • Timeline of events
  • List of evacuees
  • Actions taken
  • Damage assessment
  • Names of emergency responders
Medical Emergency Response - Dubai
medical

Medical Emergency Response Protocol

Aligned with Dubai Health Authority (DHA) emergency medical services guidelines.

When to Use:

  • Person unconscious or unresponsive
  • Difficulty breathing or chest pain
  • Severe bleeding or trauma
  • Suspected stroke or heart attack
  • Severe allergic reaction
  • Poisoning or overdose

Emergency Contacts:

  • Dubai Ambulance: 998 or 999
  • Dubai Health Authority: 800-342
emergency@dha.gov.ae
MEDICAL EMERGENCY - Ambulance Required Location: [SITE_NAME] Address: [SITE_ADDRESS] Nature: [EMERGENCY_TYPE] Patient Condition: [DESCRIPTION] Reported By: [GUARD_NAME] Time: [TIMESTAMP]
ASSESS THE SCENE - Ensure scene is safe before approaching patient

Safety First:

  • Check for hazards (fire, chemicals, traffic, unstable structures)
  • Ensure your own safety
  • Use PPE if available (gloves, mask)
  • Do not move patient unless immediate danger
Never put yourself in danger - you cannot help if you become a victim
CALL FOR AMBULANCE - Dial 998 or 999 immediately

Information to Provide:

  • Exact location with landmarks
  • Nature of medical emergency
  • Number of patients
  • Patient's condition and consciousness level
  • Any known allergies or medical conditions
  • Your callback number

Stay on the line - Dispatcher may provide first aid instructions.
Accurate information saves lives - be calm and clear
CHECK RESPONSIVENESS - Assess patient's level of consciousness

AVPU Assessment:

  • Alert - Patient is awake and aware
  • Voice - Patient responds to voice
  • Pain - Patient responds only to painful stimuli
  • Unresponsive - No response

Gently tap shoulder and ask loudly: "Are you okay?"

Note the response level for ambulance crew.
CHECK ABC - Airway, Breathing, Circulation

Primary Survey:

  • Airway - Is airway clear? Any obstruction?
  • Breathing - Is patient breathing? Rate and depth?
  • Circulation - Check pulse. Any severe bleeding?

If not breathing: Begin CPR if trained (30 compressions, 2 breaths)

If severe bleeding: Apply direct pressure with clean cloth
If patient is not breathing and you are CPR trained, start immediately - do not wait for ambulance
POSITION PATIENT - Place in recovery position if unconscious but breathing

Recovery Position (if unconscious but breathing):

  • Place patient on their side
  • Head tilted back to keep airway open
  • Top arm and leg bent for stability
  • Monitor breathing continuously

DO NOT MOVE if suspected spinal injury
Do not move patient if spinal injury suspected (fall, vehicle accident, head trauma)
CONTROL BLEEDING - Apply pressure to any wounds

Bleeding Control:

  • Use clean cloth or gauze
  • Apply firm, direct pressure
  • Elevate injured area if possible
  • Do not remove cloth if soaked - add more on top
  • Use pressure points if direct pressure insufficient

Wear gloves to protect from bloodborne pathogens.
Always use gloves or barrier when dealing with blood. Risk of HIV, Hepatitis.
COMFORT AND REASSURE - Keep patient calm and warm

Patient Care:

  • Speak calmly and reassuringly
  • Explain that help is coming
  • Cover with blanket to prevent shock
  • Do not give food or water
  • Loosen tight clothing
  • Monitor vital signs
PREPARE FOR AMBULANCE - Clear access and gather patient information

Preparation:

  • Send someone to guide ambulance to location
  • Clear path to patient
  • Gather patient's medications if available
  • Prepare patient's ID and medical records
  • Note time of incident and actions taken
HANDOVER TO PARAMEDICS - Brief ambulance crew on patient condition and actions taken

Information to Provide:

  • What happened and when
  • Patient's condition when found
  • Changes in condition
  • First aid provided
  • Known allergies or medical conditions
  • Medications taken
Security Breach Response - Dubai/SIRA
security

Security Breach Response Protocol

Aligned with SIRA (Security Industry Regulatory Agency) requirements for Dubai security operations.

When to Use:

  • Unauthorized entry or trespassing
  • Burglary or theft in progress
  • Vandalism or property damage
  • Suspicious persons or activities
  • Breach of perimeter security
  • Armed intruder

Emergency Contacts:

  • Dubai Police: 999
  • Police Emergency: 901 (Police Patrol)
  • SIRA: +971 4 320 7777
emergency@dubaipolice.gov.ae
SECURITY BREACH - Police Response Required Location: [SITE_NAME] Address: [SITE_ADDRESS] Nature: [BREACH_TYPE] Suspect Description: [DESCRIPTION] Reported By: [GUARD_NAME] Time: [TIMESTAMP]
OBSERVE AND ASSESS - Evaluate the security breach from safe position

Initial Assessment:

  • Nature and severity of breach
  • Number of perpetrators
  • Weapons visible?
  • Location and movement of suspects
  • Potential danger to personnel
  • Exit routes being used

DO NOT CONFRONT armed or violent individuals.
Your safety is priority - observe from safe distance, do not engage armed suspects
CALL DUBAI POLICE - Dial 999 immediately

Information to Report:

  • Exact location and address
  • Type of security breach (burglary, trespass, etc.)
  • Number of suspects and descriptions
  • Whether armed
  • Direction of travel/escape
  • Vehicle descriptions if applicable
  • Any injuries or hostages
ACTIVATE ALARM SYSTEMS - Trigger building security alarms

Alarm Activation:

  • Activate main security alarm
  • Trigger panic button if available
  • Lock down access control systems
  • Activate CCTV recording
  • Sound evacuation alarm if necessary
SECURE OCCUPANTS - Move personnel to safe areas

If Armed Intruder - RUN, HIDE, FIGHT:

  • RUN: Evacuate if safe escape route available
  • HIDE: Lock and barricade in secure room if cannot escape
  • FIGHT: As absolute last resort if life in immediate danger

For Other Breaches:

  • Move personnel away from breach area
  • Lock doors and secure rooms
  • Account for all personnel
  • Keep people calm and quiet
Life safety is paramount - evacuate or hide, do not confront armed suspects
DOCUMENT SUSPECTS - Obtain detailed descriptions and photos if safe

Suspect Description:

  • Number of suspects
  • Gender, age, height, build
  • Clothing description
  • Distinctive features (scars, tattoos, etc.)
  • Weapons or tools carried
  • Direction of travel
  • Vehicle details (make, model, color, plate number)

Take photos/video from SAFE DISTANCE if possible.
Only document if it can be done safely - do not risk confrontation
PRESERVE EVIDENCE - Secure the scene for police investigation

Evidence Preservation:

  • Do not touch or move anything
  • Secure area with barrier tape if available
  • Prevent unauthorized access
  • Note position of items
  • Secure CCTV footage
  • Document scene with photos
  • List of potential witnesses
COORDINATE WITH POLICE - Brief responding officers upon arrival

Information for Police:

  • What happened - timeline of events
  • Suspect descriptions and direction
  • Property stolen or damaged
  • Witness information
  • CCTV footage available
  • Building layout and access points
  • Actions taken by security
INCIDENT REPORT - Complete detailed incident documentation

Report Must Include:

  • Date, time, and location
  • Detailed narrative of incident
  • Suspect descriptions
  • Property involved
  • Witnesses
  • Actions taken
  • Police case number
  • Photos and evidence
  • SIRA notification if required
Building Evacuation Protocol - Dubai
evacuation

Building Evacuation Protocol

General evacuation procedure for all emergency types requiring building evacuation.

When to Use:

  • Fire alarm activation
  • Gas leak
  • Bomb threat
  • Structural damage
  • Chemical spill
  • Any emergency requiring immediate evacuation
SOUND EVACUATION ALARM - Activate building alarm system

Activate the building evacuation alarm using designated alarm points.

If alarm system unavailable, announce evacuation loudly and clearly.
ANNOUNCE EVACUATION - Make clear announcement to all occupants

Announcement Message:

"Attention all personnel. This is an emergency evacuation. Please evacuate the building immediately using the nearest safe exit. Do not use elevators. Proceed calmly to the assembly point."

Repeat announcement multiple times in English and Arabic.
SYSTEMATIC FLOOR SWEEP - Check all areas for remaining occupants

Room Clearing Procedure:

  • Check all offices, restrooms, storage rooms
  • Open doors and announce: "Emergency evacuation!"
  • Check behind doors and under desks
  • Mark checked rooms (chalk mark on door if available)
  • Do not lock doors
  • Check stairwells for stragglers
Do not spend excessive time searching if life-threatening situation - your safety first
ASSIST VULNERABLE PERSONS - Help elderly, disabled, or injured to evacuate

Assistance Priorities:

  • Identify persons needing assistance
  • Wheelchair users - assist to stairwell, request help
  • Visually impaired - guide by arm, describe route
  • Injured - support as needed, get help if severe
  • Pregnant women and elderly - offer assistance
  • Children - keep together, calm and guide
DIRECT TO EXITS - Guide evacuees to nearest safe exit

Exit Guidance:

  • Direct to nearest safe exit
  • Use stairs ONLY - never elevators
  • Stay to right to allow emergency personnel up
  • If exit blocked, use alternate route
  • Move quickly but do not run
  • Keep talking to calm people
ASSEMBLY POINT - Direct all evacuees to designated meeting point

Assembly Point Procedures:

  • Direct evacuees to designated assembly point
  • Keep minimum 50 meters from building
  • Keep roads clear for emergency vehicles
  • Organize evacuees by department/floor
  • Begin headcount
  • Do not allow re-entry
CONDUCT HEADCOUNT - Account for all personnel

Headcount Procedure:

  • Use sign-in sheets or employee roster
  • Check against visitor log
  • Identify any missing persons
  • Note last known location of missing persons
  • Report missing persons to emergency services immediately
  • Do NOT send anyone back to search
REPORT STATUS - Brief emergency responders on evacuation status

Status Report:

  • Total number evacuated
  • Any missing persons and last known locations
  • Areas checked
  • Any injuries requiring medical attention
  • Unusual observations during evacuation
Earthquake/Seismic Event Response - Dubai
natural

Earthquake/Seismic Event Response

Response procedures for earthquake or major seismic activity.

When to Use:

  • Ground shaking/tremors felt
  • Earthquake warning issued
  • Structural damage from seismic activity

While earthquakes are rare in Dubai, the UAE is in a seismically active region and proper response procedures are essential.
DROP, COVER, AND HOLD ON - Immediate protective action during shaking

During Shaking - DO NOT RUN OUTSIDE:

  • DROP to hands and knees
  • COVER head and neck under sturdy desk/table
  • HOLD ON to shelter and be ready to move with it

If No Shelter:

  • Stay away from windows, glass, and heavy objects
  • Cover head and neck with arms
  • Move to interior wall if possible
DO NOT run outside during shaking - most injuries occur from falling debris at exits
WAIT FOR SHAKING TO STOP - Remain in protective position until movement ceases

Stay in protected position until shaking completely stops.

Be prepared for aftershocks - they may occur minutes to hours after main shock.
ASSESS IMMEDIATE HAZARDS - Check for injuries and immediate dangers

Safety Assessment:

  • Check yourself for injuries
  • Check others nearby
  • Look for fire or smell of gas
  • Check for structural damage
  • Identify blocked exits
  • Note fallen objects and debris
EVACUATE IF NECESSARY - Exit building if structural damage or hazards present

Evacuate if:

  • Visible structural damage (cracks, collapse)
  • Gas leak detected
  • Fire or smoke
  • Building alarm activated
  • Ordered by authorities

During Evacuation:

  • Use stairs only - no elevators
  • Watch for falling debris
  • Stay away from walls and windows
  • Be prepared to drop and cover if aftershock occurs
Watch for falling debris, broken glass, and downed power lines during evacuation
CALL FOR HELP - Contact emergency services if injuries or major damage

Emergency Numbers:

  • Police: 999
  • Ambulance: 998
  • Civil Defense: 997

Report injuries, fires, gas leaks, or structural damage.
Chemical Spill Response - Dubai
chemical

Chemical Spill Emergency Response

Response procedures for hazardous material spills and chemical emergencies.

When to Use:

  • Chemical spill or leak
  • Unknown substance release
  • Toxic fumes or vapors
  • Hazardous material exposure

Emergency Contacts:

  • Civil Defense: 997
  • Dubai Municipality: 800-900
  • Poison Control: 800-POISON
EVACUATE IMMEDIATE AREA - Clear area around spill

Immediate Actions:

  • Move away from spill
  • Do not walk through spilled material
  • Evacuate immediate area
  • Close doors to contain if safe to do so
  • Warn others in vicinity
Do not touch or smell unknown substances - many are hazardous by skin contact or inhalation
CALL CIVIL DEFENSE - Report hazmat incident (997)

Information to Provide:

  • Location of spill
  • Type of chemical (if known)
  • Amount spilled
  • Any injuries or exposures
  • Whether contained or spreading
  • Ventilation status
ISOLATE AREA - Prevent access to contaminated zone

Containment Actions:

  • Secure area with barriers
  • Post warning signs
  • Shut off ventilation if spreading fumes
  • Close doors and windows
  • Prevent ignition sources if flammable
IDENTIFY EXPOSED PERSONS - Check for anyone contaminated

For Exposed Persons:

  • Move to fresh air immediately
  • Remove contaminated clothing
  • Flush affected skin with water for 15 minutes
  • If eyes exposed, flush with water for 15 minutes
  • Do not rub eyes or skin
  • Seek medical attention
Always flush chemical exposures with copious water - 15 minutes minimum
OBTAIN SDS - Locate Safety Data Sheet for chemical

If chemical is known, obtain the Safety Data Sheet (SDS/MSDS) to provide to emergency responders.

SDS Contains:

  • Chemical hazards
  • First aid measures
  • Firefighting measures
  • Spill cleanup procedures
  • PPE requirements
Power Outage Response - Dubai
power

Power Outage Emergency Response

Procedures for managing facility during electrical power failure.

When to Use:

  • Complete power failure
  • Partial power outage
  • Emergency lighting activation

Contact:

  • DEWA (Dubai Electricity and Water Authority): 991
  • DEWA Emergency: 04-601-9999
ASSESS SITUATION - Determine scope of power failure

Initial Assessment:

  • Is outage affecting entire building or just areas?
  • Are neighboring buildings affected?
  • Is emergency lighting functioning?
  • Are backup generators activated?
  • Time of outage
NOTIFY DEWA - Report power outage to utility company

Call DEWA: 991 or 04-601-9999

Information to Provide:

  • Location and account number
  • Scope of outage
  • Time of failure
  • Any unusual circumstances
ACTIVATE EMERGENCY LIGHTING - Deploy flashlights and emergency lights

Lighting Actions:

  • Verify emergency lights are functioning
  • Distribute flashlights to guards
  • Place lights in critical areas (exits, stairs)
  • Check backup generator
SECURE BUILDING - Check security systems and access control

Security Measures:

  • Check status of electronic locks
  • Verify alarm systems on battery backup
  • Manually secure any failed access points
  • Increase physical patrols
  • Monitor for unauthorized entry
Security systems may fail during power outages - compensate with increased physical security
ASSIST TRAPPED PERSONS - Check for people stuck in elevators

Elevator Emergency:

  • Use elevator phone/intercom if functioning
  • Reassure trapped persons
  • Do not attempt manual rescue
  • Call elevator maintenance company
  • Call 999 if persons in distress or medical emergency
MONITOR CRITICAL SYSTEMS - Check status of essential equipment

Systems to Monitor:

  • Fire alarm system
  • HVAC (especially in server rooms)
  • Refrigeration (if applicable)
  • Water pumps
  • Communication systems
  • Medical equipment
